title: Ostomy Supply Program Backing for Convex Barriers Above the Allowance
content:
For a convex-barrier (A4407) refill of the Ostomy Supply Program, and only for such a refill, a medical record with purpose over-limit justification backs the barriers above the allowance only while it is fewer than the tier's over-limit record months old in whole calendar months, and it backs at most twelve 30-day blocks of the order's excess instead of raising the allowance.

## Extra cover available

The extra cover available depends on what backs the extra barriers: a medical record with purpose over-limit justification dated fewer than the tier's over-limit record months, counted in whole calendar months, before today covers twelve 30-day blocks of the order's excess; where no such record exists and the customer's most recent liability notice for the convex barrier was signed on or after the newest written order's date, the cover is the units that notice covers; otherwise there is no extra cover.

The extra barriers are added to the standard units, never more than the extra cover available.

| What backs the extra barriers | Extra cover available |
|---|---|
| A medical record whose recorded purpose is over-limit justification, fewer than the tier's over-limit record months old in whole calendar months | Twelve 30-day blocks of the order's excess: the excess per 30 days times 12 |
| No such record; the most recent liability notice for the convex barrier signed on or after the newest written order's date | The units that notice covers |
| Otherwise | None |

**Over-limit record months by tier.** The record's age is the whole calendar months from its visit date to today, and the record counts only while that age is fewer than:

| Tier | Over-limit record months |
|---|---|
| Ostomy Self-Pay Program | 0 (no record counts) |
| Ostomy Commercial HMO Program | 6 |
| Ostomy Commercial PPO Program | 6 |
| Ostomy Medicare Advantage Program | 6 |
| Ostomy Original Medicare Program | 6 |
| Ostomy Medicaid Program | 6 |

## Cases (hypothetical, excess of 8 per 30 days, a tier with 6 record months)

- Record 5 whole months old: cover of 8 multiplied by 12, that is 96 barriers.
- Record 6 whole months old: no longer counts; a notice for 20 units signed after the newest order's date gives a cover of 20.
- No record; the most recent notice was signed before the newest order's date: no extra cover.
